scripts.v2:gen: go tool buf generate && go tool buf generate --template buf.gen.thirdparty.yaml
scripts.v2:up:full: docker compose -f deploy/compose/compose.yaml --profile core --profile full up -d --wait
scripts.v2:down: docker compose -f deploy/compose/compose.yaml --profile core --profile full down
scripts.v2:lint: go tool golangci-lint run ./... && go tool buf lint
